description: TSIS-CORSIM provides a traffic-analysis environment and microscopic simulator for surface streets, freeways and their intersections. The provider is University of Florida, McTrans Center. Geographical and temporal coverage: McTrans documents TSIS project management and CORSIM traffic and traffic-control simulation. The linked provider page supplies the access route and documentation; the resource payload was not retrieved. The licence is not stated in inspected metadata. The provider offers it commercially; the price is not recorded here. For simulation, the documented contents can support transport network modelling and capacity planning. This use is an interpretation of the metadata, not a tested integration. No directly related existing catalogue record was established.
